options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: file_interface_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the file interface.

options.name: gateway
options.description: Gateway address for the network interface. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IP address of the network interface. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

options.name: ip_port_id
options.description: Unique Identifier of the IP Port that is associated with the file interface.

options.name: is_destination_override_enabled
options.description: Used in replication context when the user wants to override the settings on the destination.

options.name: is_disabled
options.description: Indicates whether the network interface is disabled.

options.name: nas_server
options.description: Unique identifier/name of the NAS server to which the network interface belongs, as defined by the I(nas_server) resource type.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: prefix_length
options.description: Prefix length for the interface. IPv4 and IPv6 are supported.

options.name: role
options.description: C(Production) type of network interface is used for all file protocols and services of a NAS server. This type of interface is inactive while a NAS server is in destination mode. C(Backup) type of network interface is used only for NDMP/NFS backup or disaster recovery testing. This type of interface is always active in all NAS server modes. C(System) type of interface are reserved for system traffic such as for NAS server migration, they can not be used for the production traffic. C(System) type

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the file interface should exist or not. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: Virtual Local Area Network (VLAN) identifier for the interface.
